additional_maps.title: Additional Map Servers
additional_maps.description: Run more maps from this installation. Each enabled map has its own CMD, ports and saved world; all maps share this instance's configuration, mods and cluster transfers.

server_name.title: Server Name
server_name.description: Displayed in the in-game server browser.

map_name.title: Map Name
map_name.description: Map package to load at startup; use an identifier supported by this edition and installed content.

x-lsgm-suggestions.label: Scorched Earth
x-lsgm-suggestions.x-lsgm-label-zh-CN: 焦土飞升 / 焦土 / Scorched Earth

x-lsgm-suggestions.label: The Center
x-lsgm-suggestions.x-lsgm-label-zh-CN: 中心岛飞升 / 中心岛 / The Center

x-lsgm-suggestions.label: Aberration
x-lsgm-suggestions.x-lsgm-label-zh-CN: 畸变飞升 / 畸变 / Aberration

x-lsgm-suggestions.label: Extinction
x-lsgm-suggestions.x-lsgm-label-zh-CN: 灭绝飞升 / 灭绝 / Extinction

x-lsgm-suggestions.label: Ragnarok
x-lsgm-suggestions.x-lsgm-label-zh-CN: 仙境飞升 / 仙境 / Ragnarok

x-lsgm-suggestions.label: Valguero
x-lsgm-suggestions.x-lsgm-label-zh-CN: 瓦尔盖罗飞升 / 瓦尔盖罗 / Valguero

x-lsgm-suggestions.label: Genesis: Part 1
x-lsgm-suggestions.x-lsgm-label-zh-CN: 创世第一部分飞升 / Genesis: Part 1

max_players.title: Max Players
max_players.description: Maximum number of simultaneously connected players.

active_event.title: Active Event
active_event.description: Select a seasonal event supported by the installed server version.

auto_save_period_minutes.title: Auto Save Period Minutes
auto_save_period_minutes.description: How often the server writes a world save to disk.

ban_list_url.title: Ban List URL
ban_list_url.description: Optional remote ban-list URL the server should load on boot. LanGame will quote it correctly in GameUserSettings.ini.

show_floating_damage_text.title: Show Floating Damage Text
show_floating_damage_text.description: Shows RPG-style floating damage numbers to players.

server_hardcore.title: Server Hardcore
server_hardcore.description: Enable hardcore mode, where survivor death resets the character's level.

server_force_no_hud.title: Force No HUD
server_force_no_hud.description: Forces the in-game HUD off for every player.

kick_idle_players_period.title: Kick Idle Players Period Seconds
kick_idle_players_period.description: Idle timeout in seconds used with -EnableIdlePlayerKick.

enable_idle_player_kick.title: Enable Idle Player Kick
enable_idle_player_kick.description: Disconnect inactive players after the configured idle timeout.

no_transfer_from_filtering.title: Block Non-Cluster Tribute Path
no_transfer_from_filtering.description: Adds -NoTransferFromFiltering to fully block ARK Data usage between single player and servers outside the current cluster.

cluster_id.title: Cluster ID
cluster_id.description: Maps in one cluster must use the same ID and shared cluster directory. Setting only the ID keeps each instance's uploads separate.

cluster_directory.title: Shared Cluster Directory
cluster_directory.description: Absolute directory shared by maps in this cluster, including a local drive or UNC share. Leave empty to keep this instance's local cluster directory. Existing uploads are not moved when the directory changes.

no_tribute_downloads.title: Disable Tribute Downloads
no_tribute_downloads.description: Blocks downloading survivors, dinos, and items from tribute storage.

prevent_download_survivors.title: Prevent Download Survivors
prevent_download_survivors.description: Blocks survivor character downloads from the cluster.

prevent_download_items.title: Prevent Download Items
prevent_download_items.description: Blocks item downloads from tribute storage.

prevent_download_dinos.title: Prevent Download Dinos
prevent_download_dinos.description: Blocks dino downloads from tribute storage.

prevent_upload_survivors.title: Prevent Upload Survivors
prevent_upload_survivors.description: Blocks survivor character uploads into tribute storage.

prevent_upload_items.title: Prevent Upload Items
prevent_upload_items.description: Blocks item uploads into tribute storage.

prevent_upload_dinos.title: Prevent Upload Dinos
prevent_upload_dinos.description: Blocks dino uploads into tribute storage.

max_tribute_dinos.title: Max Tribute Dinos
max_tribute_dinos.description: Maximum dinos stored in tribute at once.

max_tribute_items.title: Max Tribute Items
max_tribute_items.description: Maximum tribute items stored at once.

rcon_enabled.title: Enable RCON
rcon_enabled.description: Enables remote RCON commands, including player-management commands. Written to GameUserSettings.ini [ServerSettings] as RCONEnabled.

battleye_enabled.title: Enable BattlEye
battleye_enabled.description: Enable BattlEye anti-cheat; disabling it starts the server with -NoBattlEye.

exclusive_join_enabled.title: Enable Exclusive Join
exclusive_join_enabled.description: Restricts joins to PlayersExclusiveJoinList.txt when enabled.

exclusive_join_list.title: Exclusive Join List
exclusive_join_list.description: One account ID per line. LanGame renders PlayersExclusiveJoinList.txt for the dedicated server to read.

priority_join_list.title: Priority Join List
priority_join_list.description: One account ID per line. LanGame renders PlayersJoinNoCheckList.txt for the dedicated server to read.

admin_password.title: Admin Password
admin_password.description: Authenticates administrator console access and RCON player commands. Written to GameUserSettings.ini [ServerSettings] as ServerAdminPassword.

admin_account_ids.title: Admin Account IDs
admin_account_ids.description: One account ID per line. LanGame renders AllowedCheaterAccountIDs.txt for the dedicated server to read.

bad_word_list_url.title: Bad Word List URL
bad_word_list_url.description: Custom URL for the blocked-word list. Leave the default official list if you do not host your own.

bad_word_whitelist_url.title: Bad Word Whitelist URL
bad_word_whitelist_url.description: Optional allow-list URL used to permit false positives.

server_pve.title: PVE Mode
server_pve.description: Runs the server with PvE rules when enabled.

allow_third_person_player.title: Allow Third Person
allow_third_person_player.description: Lets players switch to third-person view.

show_map_player_location.title: Show Player on Map
show_map_player_location.description: Show the player's current position on the in-game map.

allow_flyer_carry_pve.title: Allow Flyer Carry in PVE
allow_flyer_carry_pve.description: Allows flyer carry while the server is running in PvE mode.

allow_multiple_attached_c4.title: Allow Multiple Attached C4
allow_multiple_attached_c4.description: Allows more than one C4 charge to be attached to a creature.

allow_raid_dino_feeding.title: Allow Raid Dino Feeding
allow_raid_dino_feeding.description: Allows Titanosaurs and other raid dinos to be permanently fed where supported.

proximity_chat.title: Nearby Text Chat
proximity_chat.description: Restrict text chat visibility to nearby players.

allow_hit_markers.title: Allow Hit Markers
allow_hit_markers.description: Keeps optional ranged hit markers enabled for players.

disable_weather_fog.title: Disable Weather Fog
disable_weather_fog.description: Disables fog so players have clearer visibility during weather effects.

enable_pvp_gamma.title: Enable PVP Gamma
enable_pvp_gamma.description: Allows the gamma console command while the server is running in PvP mode.

disable_pve_gamma.title: Disable PVE Gamma
disable_pve_gamma.description: Prevents the gamma console command while the server is running in PvE mode.

prevent_spawn_animations.title: Prevent Spawn Animations
prevent_spawn_animations.description: Skips spawn intro animation delays where supported.

use_astraeos_traversal_buff.title: Use Astraeos Traversal Buff
use_astraeos_traversal_buff.description: Keeps Astraeos biome traversal teleport available while holding the reload action.

allow_cave_building_pve.title: Allow Cave Building in PVE
allow_cave_building_pve.description: Allow building inside caves on PvE servers.

prevent_offline_pvp.title: Prevent Offline PVP
prevent_offline_pvp.description: Protect structures and tames belonging to offline players from PvP damage.

prevent_offline_pvp_interval.title: Offline PVP Delay Seconds
prevent_offline_pvp_interval.description: Delay in seconds after owners go offline before offline PvP protection begins.

prevent_template_on_saddle.title: Prevent Templates On Platform Saddles
prevent_template_on_saddle.description: Prevents placing building templates on platform saddles. Leave unset to use the game default.

override_structure_platform_prevention.title: Override Platform Build Prevention
override_structure_platform_prevention.description: Allow structures normally prohibited on platform saddles, such as automated turrets.

enable_extra_structure_prevention_volume.title: Enable Extra Structure Prevention Volumes
enable_extra_structure_prevention_volume.description: Blocks building in special resource-rich map volumes such as major mountains on The Island.

pve_allow_structures_at_supply_drops.title: PVE Allow Structures At Supply Drops
pve_allow_structures_at_supply_drops.description: Allows building near supply drop locations while in PvE mode.

force_all_structure_locking.title: Force All Structure Locking
force_all_structure_locking.description: Defaults newly placed structures to locked.

disable_dino_decay_pve.title: Disable Dino Decay in PVE
disable_dino_decay_pve.description: Disables PvE tame ownership decay so abandoned dinos do not become claimable over time.

pve_dino_decay_period_multiplier.title: PVE Dino Decay Period Multiplier
pve_dino_decay_period_multiplier.description: Scales how long abandoned PvE dinos keep their ownership before decaying.

disable_structure_placement_collision.title: Disable Structure Placement Collision
disable_structure_placement_collision.description: Disables placement collision checks so structures can clip into terrain, foliage, and nearby pieces where the server allows it.

needs_power_to_activate_aquatic_compartm.title: Aquatic Compartments Require Power
needs_power_to_activate_aquatic_compartm.description: Requires powered activation before an aquatic compartment can operate.

structure_pickup_time_after_placement.title: Structure Pickup Time After Placement Seconds
structure_pickup_time_after_placement.description: Seconds after placing a structure during which quick pickup remains available.

structure_pickup_hold_duration.title: Structure Pickup Hold Duration Seconds
structure_pickup_hold_duration.description: Seconds to hold the quick-pickup action; 0 makes pickup immediate.

the_max_structures_in_range.title: Max Structures In Range
the_max_structures_in_range.description: Maximum structures allowed within the hard-coded placement radius.

enable_auto_destroy_structures.title: Enable Auto Destroy Structures
enable_auto_destroy_structures.description: Enable automatic removal of old structures using the configured destruction timers.

destroy_tames_over_soft_tame_limit.title: Destroy Tames Over Soft Tame Limit
destroy_tames_over_soft_tame_limit.description: Marks and eventually destroys tames that stay above the soft tame cap.

max_tamed_dinos_soft_tame_limit.title: Soft Tame Limit
max_tamed_dinos_soft_tame_limit.description: Server-wide soft tame limit used before cleanup rules start counting down.

max_tamed_dinos_soft_tame_limit_countdow.title: Soft Tame Deletion Countdown Seconds
max_tamed_dinos_soft_tame_limit_countdow.description: Countdown in seconds before marked tames above the soft cap are destroyed.

disable_burrow_decay_timers.title: Disable Burrow Decay Timers
disable_burrow_decay_timers.description: Turns off decay timers for tamed Burrowbuck burrows.

max_anchored_vessels_in_range.title: Max Anchored Vessels In Range
max_anchored_vessels_in_range.description: Maximum number of anchored ships allowed inside the vessel check radius.

anchored_vessel_check_radius.title: Anchored Vessel Check Radius
anchored_vessel_check_radius.description: Radius in Unreal Units used when enforcing the anchored-vessel limit.

difficulty_offset.title: Difficulty Offset
difficulty_offset.description: Base difficulty factor affecting wild levels and loot quality; the map and official-difficulty override also affect the result.

override_official_difficulty.title: Override Official Difficulty
override_official_difficulty.description: Override the map's difficulty value, affecting wild creature level limits and loot quality.

day_cycle_speed_scale.title: Day Cycle Speed Scale
day_cycle_speed_scale.description: Scale the whole day-night cycle speed; higher values shorten the cycle.

day_time_speed_scale.title: Day Time Speed Scale
day_time_speed_scale.description: Scale daytime clock speed; higher values shorten daylight hours.

night_time_speed_scale.title: Night Time Speed Scale
night_time_speed_scale.description: Scale nighttime clock speed; higher values shorten the night.

player_character_health_recovery_multipl.title: Player Health Recovery Multiplier
player_character_health_recovery_multipl.description: Scales natural health regeneration for players.

player_character_stamina_drain_multiplie.title: Player Stamina Drain Multiplier
player_character_stamina_drain_multiplie.description: Scales how quickly players spend stamina while sprinting, jumping, and fighting.

resources_respawn_period_multiplier.title: Resources Respawn Period Multiplier
resources_respawn_period_multiplier.description: Scale the delay before harvested resources respawn; higher values mean a longer wait.

item_stack_size_multiplier.title: Item Stack Size Multiplier
item_stack_size_multiplier.description: Global stack-size multiplier for items that support stacking.

prevent_diseases.title: Prevent Diseases
prevent_diseases.description: Stops swamp fever and other disease mechanics from spreading on the server.

use_singleplayer_settings.title: Use Singleplayer Settings
use_singleplayer_settings.description: Apply the game's single-player balancing preset, including taming and breeding adjustments.

show_creative_mode.title: Show Creative Mode
show_creative_mode.description: Keeps the creative-mode toggle visible to eligible players and admins.

use_dino_level_up_animations.title: Use Dino Level-Up Animations
use_dino_level_up_animations.description: Keeps the default level-up animation on tamed creatures instead of suppressing it.

prevent_mate_boost.title: Prevent Mate Boost
prevent_mate_boost.description: Disables the mate-boost bonus that nearby breeding pairs normally grant one another.

player_damage_multiplier.title: Player Damage Multiplier
player_damage_multiplier.description: Scales the damage dealt by player attacks.

player_resistance_multiplier.title: Player Resistance Multiplier
player_resistance_multiplier.description: Scales how much incoming damage players take.

dino_damage_multiplier.title: Wild Dino Damage Multiplier
dino_damage_multiplier.description: Scale creature attack damage; higher values increase damage dealt.

dino_resistance_multiplier.title: Wild Dino Resistance Multiplier
dino_resistance_multiplier.description: Scale damage received by creatures; higher values make them take more damage.

structure_resistance_multiplier.title: Structure Resistance Multiplier
structure_resistance_multiplier.description: Scales how much incoming damage structures take from attacks.

use_dynamic_config.title: Use Dynamic Config
use_dynamic_config.description: Load supported runtime-adjustable settings from the configured dynamic-configuration URL.

custom_live_tuning_url.title: Custom Live Tuning URL
custom_live_tuning_url.description: Stored in GameUserSettings.ini as CustomLiveTuningUrl so the server can fetch live tuning overloads JSON. Official ASA clusters use https://cdn2.arkdedicated.com/asa/livetuningoverloads.json.

disable_cryopod_enemy_check.title: Disable Cryopod Enemy Check
disable_cryopod_enemy_check.description: Allows deploying cryopods without the nearby-enemy restriction.

disable_cryopod_fridge_requirement.title: Disable Cryopod Fridge Requirement
disable_cryopod_fridge_requirement.description: Removes the cryofridge placement requirement for cryopods.

allow_cryo_fridge_on_saddle.title: Allow Cryo Fridge On Saddle
allow_cryo_fridge_on_saddle.description: Allows cryofridges to be placed on platform saddles when supported by ASA.

resource_no_replenish_radius_players.title: Resource No Replenish Radius Players
resource_no_replenish_radius_players.description: Player-side no-respawn radius for nearby resources.

resource_no_replenish_radius_structures.title: Resource No Replenish Radius Structures
resource_no_replenish_radius_structures.description: Structure-side no-respawn radius for nearby resources.

poop_interval_multiplier.title: Poop Interval Multiplier
poop_interval_multiplier.description: Scale the interval between defecations; higher values mean less frequent defecation.

mating_interval_multiplier.title: Mating Interval Multiplier
mating_interval_multiplier.description: Lower values shorten the cooldown between mating windows.

baby_cuddle_interval_multiplier.title: Baby Cuddle Interval Multiplier
baby_cuddle_interval_multiplier.description: Lower values shorten imprint cuddle intervals.

lay_egg_interval_multiplier.title: Lay Egg Interval Multiplier
lay_egg_interval_multiplier.description: Scale the interval between egg-laying attempts; higher values mean less frequent eggs.

baby_food_consumption_speed_multiplier.title: Baby Food Consumption Speed Multiplier
baby_food_consumption_speed_multiplier.description: Controls how quickly babies consume food.

baby_cuddle_grace_period_multiplier.title: Baby Cuddle Grace Period Multiplier
baby_cuddle_grace_period_multiplier.description: Controls how forgiving imprint timing is.

baby_cuddle_lose_imprint_quality_speed_m.title: Baby Cuddle Lose Imprint Quality Speed Multiplier
baby_cuddle_lose_imprint_quality_speed_m.description: Controls how quickly missed imprint quality is lost.

baby_imprinting_stat_scale_multiplier.title: Baby Imprinting Stat Scale Multiplier
baby_imprinting_stat_scale_multiplier.description: Controls the stat bonus granted by imprinting.

baby_imprint_amount_multiplier.title: Baby Imprint Amount Multiplier
baby_imprint_amount_multiplier.description: Controls how much imprint quality each interaction grants.

allow_anyone_baby_imprint_cuddle.title: Allow Anyone Baby Imprint Cuddle
allow_anyone_baby_imprint_cuddle.description: Lets tribe members handle imprint cuddle interactions.

disable_imprint_dino_buff.title: Disable Imprint Dino Buff
disable_imprint_dino_buff.description: Disables the rider buff from imprinting.

override_named_engram_entries.title: Override Named Engram Entries
override_named_engram_entries.description: One rule per line. The render step adds OverrideNamedEngramEntries= if omitted.

level_experience_ramp_overrides.title: Level Experience Ramp Overrides
level_experience_ramp_overrides.description: One rule per line. The render step adds LevelExperienceRampOverrides= if omitted.

config_add_npc_spawn_entries_container.title: Config Add NPC Spawn Entries Container
config_add_npc_spawn_entries_container.description: One rule per line. The render step adds ConfigAddNPCSpawnEntriesContainer= if omitted.

random_supply_crate_points.title: Random Supply Crate Points
random_supply_crate_points.description: Place supply drops at randomized locations.

custom_recipe_effectiveness_multiplier.title: Custom Recipe Effectiveness Multiplier
custom_recipe_effectiveness_multiplier.description: Scale the effects of custom food and drink recipes; larger values make recipes more effective.

custom_recipe_skill_multiplier.title: Custom Recipe Skill Multiplier
custom_recipe_skill_multiplier.description: Scale the contribution of Crafting Skill to custom recipe effects.

mod_ids_csv.title: Mods
mod_ids_csv.description: Comma-separated ASA mod IDs for the -mods launch flag.

passive_mod_ids_csv.title: Passive Mods
passive_mod_ids_csv.description: Comma-separated or one-per-line ASA mod IDs loaded with -passivemods without making them active gameplay mods.

server_game_log.title: Enable Server Game Log
server_game_log.description: Write gameplay events to the server game log.

server_game_log_include_tribe_logs.title: Include Tribe Logs
server_game_log_include_tribe_logs.description: Include tribe events in server game logs and RCON log output.

allow_hide_damage_source_from_logs.title: Allow Hide Damage Source From Logs
allow_hide_damage_source_from_logs.description: If false, damage sources are shown in tribe logs instead of being hidden.

custom_launch_flags.title: Custom Launch Flags
custom_launch_flags.description: Extra launch flags separated by spaces.

game_ini_extra.title: Extra Game.ini
game_ini_extra.description: Raw extra lines for Game.ini, including repeatable directives such as PreventBreedingForClassNames.

always_tick_dedicated_skeletal_meshes.title: -AlwaysTickDedicatedSkeletalMeshes
always_tick_dedicated_skeletal_meshes.description: Keeps creature skeletal animations updating on the server, including idle creatures. This disables the optimization that skips those updates when server frame rates are low.

culture.title: -culture
culture.description: Selects the language used for server output. This does not change the language chosen by connected players.

do_custom_cosmetic_validation.title: -DoCustomCosmeticValidation
do_custom_cosmetic_validation.description: Enables the server's validation checks for custom cosmetic mods.

disable_custom_cosmetics.title: -DisableCustomCosmetics
disable_custom_cosmetics.description: Turns off the Custom Cosmetic system, which otherwise supports cosmetic mods downloaded automatically by connected clients.

disabledinonetrangescaling.title: -disabledinonetrangescaling
disabledinonetrangescaling.description: Turns off the optimization that scales how far creature updates are replicated to clients.

easter_colors.title: -EasterColors
easter_colors.description: Gives newly spawned creatures a chance to use Easter event colors.

force_allow_cave_flyers.title: -ForceAllowCaveFlyers
force_allow_cave_flyers.description: Allows flying creatures to enter caves even where the map would normally restrict them.

force_respawn_dinos.title: -ForceRespawnDinos
force_respawn_dinos.description: Removes wild creatures each time the server starts so the world can repopulate them. Tamed creatures are excluded.

gbusage_to_force_restart.title: -GBUsageToForceRestart
gbusage_to_force_restart.description: Sets the memory-use threshold in gigabytes at which the server requests a world save and restart. Use 0 to disable this behavior.

no_dinos.title: -NoDinos
no_dinos.description: Stops new wild-creature spawning. This overrides all NoDinosExcept spawn exceptions, so those flags cannot restore selected spawn types while NoDinos is enabled.

no_wild_babies.title: -NoWildBabies
no_wild_babies.description: Prevents new wild baby creatures from spawning.

server_use_event_colors.title: -ServerUseEventColors
server_use_event_colors.description: Enables the game's event color variants.

stasis_keep_controllers.title: -StasisKeepControllers
stasis_keep_controllers.description: Retains actors' AI controllers in memory while those actors are in stasis, reducing the need to recreate them when players return. This uses additional memory, including when few players are connected, and can be significant on large maps.

usestore.title: -usestore
usestore.description: Stores character data with the world save instead of maintaining separate regular .arkprofile saves; temporary profiles for new or transferred characters remain until the next world save, and tribe data uses .arktributetribe. This mode supports BackupTransferPlayerDatas, uses converttostore for existing data conversion, and must accompany newsaveformat when loading official 2023 server archives.

custom_notification_url.title: -CustomNotificationURL
custom_notification_url.description: Configures the HTTP URL used for custom notifications through the server-message system. This option does not support HTTPS.

disable_character_tracker.title: -disableCharacterTracker
disable_character_tracker.description: Turns off character tracking through a launch flag. This takes precedence over UseCharacterTracker in GameUserSettings.ini.

enable_steel_shield.title: -EnableSteelShield
enable_steel_shield.description: Enables the SteelShield DDoS-protection integration on servers hosted by Nitrado. It does not provide that protection on other hosts.

forceuseperfthreads.title: -forceuseperfthreads
forceuseperfthreads.description: Requests the engine's performance-thread mode for the server.

no_ai.title: -NoAI
no_ai.description: Starts creatures without AI controller objects. Wildcard does not document this option, so it should not be treated as a general server-performance preset.

no_dinos_except_forced_spawn.title: -NoDinosExceptForcedSpawn
no_dinos_except_forced_spawn.description: Allows only forced wild-creature spawns and leaves existing wild creatures in the world. NoDinos takes precedence; enabling this also prevents the streaming, manual and water-only exception flags from taking effect. Wildcard does not document this option.

no_dinos_except_streaming_spawn.title: -NoDinosExceptStreamingSpawn
no_dinos_except_streaming_spawn.description: Allows only streaming-triggered wild-creature spawns without removing existing creatures. NoDinos and the forced-spawn exception take precedence, while the manual and water-spawn exceptions cannot take effect alongside this option. Wildcard does not document this option.

no_dinos_except_manual_spawn.title: -NoDinosExceptManualSpawn
no_dinos_except_manual_spawn.description: Allows only manual wild-creature spawns without removing creatures already present. NoDinos, the forced-spawn exception and the streaming-spawn exception take precedence; this option takes precedence over the water-spawn exception. Wildcard does not document this option.

no_dinos_except_water_spawn.title: -NoDinosExceptWaterSpawn
no_dinos_except_water_spawn.description: Allows only water-related wild-creature spawns and retains creatures already present. It has no effect if NoDinos or any forced, streaming or manual spawn exception is enabled. Wildcard does not document this option.

noperfthreads.title: -noperfthreads
noperfthreads.description: Disables the engine's performance worker threads. Wildcard does not document this option; enabling it does not establish a performance improvement.

nosound.title: -nosound
nosound.description: Disables server sound processing. Wildcard does not document this option, and its effect on resource usage depends on the workload.

onethread.title: -onethread
onethread.description: Requests single-threaded engine operation instead of multithreading. Wildcard does not document this option; use it only when that execution mode is needed.

server_platform.title: -ServerPlatform
server_platform.description: Platforms permitted to join: PC for Steam, PS5 for PlayStation 5, XSX for Xbox, and WINGDK for Microsoft Store. Combine platform codes with +, or use ALL for all supported platforms; omitting the option also permits all platforms.

unstasis_dino_obstruction_check.title: -UnstasisDinoObstructionCheck
unstasis_dino_obstruction_check.description: Requests an obstruction check when creatures leave stasis, intended to reduce creatures passing through geometry or structures as they reappear. Wildcard does not document this option.

use_server_net_speed_check.title: -UseServerNetSpeedCheck
use_server_net_speed_check.description: Limits the movement data a player can submit during one server tick by discarding excess updates. This can help constrain movement-processing load on busy servers; Wildcard does not document the full behavior.

admin_list_url.title: AdminListURL
admin_list_url.description: Loads administrator account IDs from a web resource in place of AllowedCheaterAccountIDs.txt. UpdateAllowedCheatersInterval controls how often the server checks that resource.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Controls how many seconds the message of the day remains visible when a player joins.

message.title: Message
message.description: Text shown to players after they log in. Enter it without surrounding quotes and use the literal sequence \n wherever the displayed message should start a new line.

b_allow_flyer_speed_leveling.title: bAllowFlyerSpeedLeveling
b_allow_flyer_speed_leveling.description: Lets players assign Movement Speed levels to flying creatures. Ascended also requires bAllowSpeedLeveling to be enabled.

b_allow_speed_leveling.title: bAllowSpeedLeveling
b_allow_speed_leveling.description: Allows Movement Speed level increases for survivors and creatures that do not fly. Flyer speed has its own additional setting.

b_allow_unlimited_respecs.title: bAllowUnlimitedRespecs
b_allow_unlimited_respecs.description: Removes the 24-hour wait between Mindwipe Tonic uses, allowing repeated character respecs.

b_disable_friendly_fire.title: bDisableFriendlyFire
b_disable_friendly_fire.description: Blocks damage between members of the same tribe and their tames or structures.

b_disable_photo_mode.title: bDisablePhotoMode
b_disable_photo_mode.description: Prevents players from using Photo Mode on this server.

b_disable_wireless_crafting.title: bDisableWirelessCrafting
b_disable_wireless_crafting.description: Requires crafting materials to be supplied without wireless access to Tek Dedicated Storage.

b_disable_wireless_crafting_for_dinos.title: bDisableWirelessCraftingForDinos
b_disable_wireless_crafting_for_dinos.description: Stops crafting in creature inventories from drawing materials wirelessly from Tek Dedicated Storage.

b_disable_wireless_crafting_for_players.title: bDisableWirelessCraftingForPlayers
b_disable_wireless_crafting_for_players.description: Stops crafting in a survivor's inventory from drawing materials wirelessly from Tek Dedicated Storage.

b_disable_wireless_crafting_for_structur.title: bDisableWirelessCraftingForStructures
b_disable_wireless_crafting_for_structur.description: Stops crafting stations and other structure inventories from drawing materials wirelessly from Tek Dedicated Storage.

b_ignore_structures_prevention_volumes.title: bIgnoreStructuresPreventionVolumes
b_ignore_structures_prevention_volumes.description: Allows construction in areas normally blocked by map building restrictions, including some Obelisks and the Aberration Portal. Genesis: Part 1 also has the separate bGenesisUseStructuresPreventionVolumes control for mission areas.

b_pv_edisable_friendly_fire.title: bPvEDisableFriendlyFire
b_pv_edisable_friendly_fire.description: On PvE servers, blocks damage between tribe members and their tames or structures.

crafting_skill_bonus_multiplier.title: CraftingSkillBonusMultiplier
crafting_skill_bonus_multiplier.description: Adjusts the bonus contributed by points invested in Crafting Skill. Higher values increase that bonus.

craft_xpmultiplier.title: CraftXPMultiplier
craft_xpmultiplier.description: Adjusts experience gained from crafting items. Higher values award more crafting XP.

destroy_tames_over_level_clamp.title: DestroyTamesOverLevelClamp
destroy_tames_over_level_clamp.description: Sets the highest tame level to retain at startup. The server deletes tamed creatures above this level when it starts.

exclude_item_indices.title: ExcludeItemIndices
exclude_item_indices.description: Removes specified item IDs from supply-crate loot. Repeat this entry to exclude more than one item.

limit_generators_num.title: LimitGeneratorsNum
limit_generators_num.description: Maximum number of generators permitted within the area controlled by LimitGeneratorsRange. Adjust the count and range together to define the local generator limit.

limit_generators_range.title: LimitGeneratorsRange
limit_generators_range.description: Range, in Unreal units, over which the server counts generators against LimitGeneratorsNum. This controls the area of the limit, not generator power coverage.

generic_xpmultiplier.title: GenericXPMultiplier
generic_xpmultiplier.description: Adjusts passive experience earned over time. Higher values grant more XP from this source.

global_item_decomposition_time_multiplie.title: GlobalItemDecompositionTimeMultiplier
global_item_decomposition_time_multiplie.description: Adjusts how long dropped items and loot bags remain before disappearing. Higher values extend their lifetime.

global_spoiling_time_multiplier.title: GlobalSpoilingTimeMultiplier
global_spoiling_time_multiplier.description: Adjusts the time before perishable items spoil. Higher values preserve them longer.

hair_growth_speed_multiplier.title: HairGrowthSpeedMultiplier
hair_growth_speed_multiplier.description: Adjusts how quickly survivor hair grows. Higher values accelerate growth.

harvest_resource_item_amount_class_multi.title: HarvestResourceItemAmountClassMultipliers
harvest_resource_item_amount_class_multi.description: Sets separate harvest-yield multipliers for individual resource item classes. This lets you change one resource's yield without applying the same change to every resource.

harvest_xpmultiplier.title: HarvestXPMultiplier
harvest_xpmultiplier.description: Adjusts experience gained from gathering resources. Higher values grant more harvesting XP.

kill_xpmultiplier.title: KillXPMultiplier
kill_xpmultiplier.description: XP awarded for kills, relative to the normal amount. Values above 1 increase the reward; values below 1 reduce it.

max_fall_speed_multiplier.title: MaxFallSpeedMultiplier
max_fall_speed_multiplier.description: Scales the downward-speed threshold for player fall damage. Higher values allow longer falls before damage begins, while lower values make shorter falls dangerous; gravity and movement physics are unchanged.

per_level_stats_multiplier_player_intege.title: Player stat multipliers
per_level_stats_multiplier_player_intege.description: One indexed value per line, such as [0]=1.0. The PerLevelStatsMultiplier_Player prefix is optional; blank uses game defaults.

photo_mode_range_limit.title: PhotoModeRangeLimit
photo_mode_range_limit.description: Maximum permitted separation between a player's position and the photo-mode camera. This limits camera travel without changing the player's position.

prevent_breeding_for_class_names.title: PreventBreedingForClassNames
prevent_breeding_for_class_names.description: Creature classes that must not breed. Identify each creature with its native class name, such as Argent_Character_BP_C, rather than its display name.

special_xpmultiplier.title: SpecialXPMultiplier
special_xpmultiplier.description: XP awarded from the game's SpecialEvent category, relative to its normal reward. Values above 1 increase that reward; values below 1 reduce it.

tribe_tower_bonus_multiplier.title: TribeTowerBonusMultiplier
tribe_tower_bonus_multiplier.description: Scale applied to the Tribe Tower bonus. A value of 1 keeps the normal bonus; higher or lower values increase or reduce it.

wild_dino_character_food_drain_multiplie.title: WildDinoCharacterFoodDrainMultiplier
wild_dino_character_food_drain_multiplie.description: Rate at which wild creatures use food. Values above 1 accelerate food loss; values below 1 slow it.

wireless_crafting_range_override.title: WirelessCraftingRangeOverride
wireless_crafting_range_override.description: Wireless crafting range of Tek Dedicated Storage, measured in Unreal units. This controls how far its wireless crafting access extends.

valguero_memorial_entries.title: ValgueroMemorialEntries
valguero_memorial_entries.description: Names displayed by the interactive Valguero memorial. Use this list to choose whom the memorial honors on this server.

base_hexagon_reward_multiplier.title: BaseHexagonRewardMultiplier
base_hexagon_reward_multiplier.description: Adjusts Hexagon rewards from mission scores. In Ascended, it also adjusts Club ARK token rewards; higher values increase the payout.

hexagon_cost_multiplier.title: HexagonCostMultiplier
hexagon_cost_multiplier.description: Adjusts item prices in the Hexagon Store. In Ascended, it also adjusts Club ARK token prices; higher values make purchases more expensive.

cheat_teleport_locations.title: CheatTeleportLocations
cheat_teleport_locations.description: Defines named destinations for the TP administrator command. Supply coordinates in Unreal world units, rather than the map's GPS latitude and longitude.

supply_crate_loot_quality_multiplier.title: Supply crate quality
supply_crate_loot_quality_multiplier.description: Changes supply crate loot quality. Leave blank to use the game default.

override_max_experience_points_player.title: Player XP cap
override_max_experience_points_player.description: Maximum survivor experience. Leave blank to use the game default.

override_max_experience_points_dino.title: Tamed creature XP cap
override_max_experience_points_dino.description: Maximum tamed-creature experience. Leave blank to use the game default.

auto_unlock_all_engrams.title: Unlock engrams automatically
auto_unlock_all_engrams.description: Unlocks available engrams automatically as survivors level up.

config_override_supply_crate_items.title: Supply crate contents
config_override_supply_crate_items.description: One ConfigOverrideSupplyCrateItems rule per line. The key prefix is optional; leave blank to keep the existing loot tables.

config_override_item_crafting_costs.title: Crafting costs
config_override_item_crafting_costs.description: One ConfigOverrideItemCraftingCosts rule per line. The key prefix is optional; leave blank to keep the existing recipes.

config_override_item_max_quantity.title: Item stack limits
config_override_item_max_quantity.description: One ConfigOverrideItemMaxQuantity rule per line. The key prefix is optional; leave blank to keep the existing stack limits.

config_override_npc_spawn_entries_contai.title: Spawn container overrides
config_override_npc_spawn_entries_contai.description: One ConfigOverrideNPCSpawnEntriesContainer rule per line. ASA spawn entries use NPCsToSpawnStrings with full blueprint class paths ending in _C.

config_subtract_npc_spawn_entries_contai.title: Spawn container removals
config_subtract_npc_spawn_entries_contai.description: One native removal tuple per line. ASA NPCSpawnEntries uses NPCsToSpawnStrings with full blueprint class paths ending in _C; optional NPCSpawnLimits uses NPCClassString. The ConfigSubtractNPCSpawnEntriesContainer= prefix is optional.

dino_spawn_weight_multipliers.title: Creature spawn weights
dino_spawn_weight_multipliers.description: One DinoSpawnWeightMultipliers rule per line, using DinoNameTag, SpawnWeightMultiplier, and optional spawn limits.

npc_replacements.title: Creature replacements
npc_replacements.description: One NPCReplacements rule per line, with FromClassName and ToClassName. An empty ToClassName removes that creature.

override_player_level_engram_points.title: Engram points per level
override_player_level_engram_points.description: One whole-number point value per level, in level order. The OverridePlayerLevelEngramPoints= prefix is optional.

engram_entry_auto_unlocks.title: Engram unlock levels
engram_entry_auto_unlocks.description: One EngramEntryAutoUnlocks rule per line, with EngramClassName and LevelToAutoUnlock.

per_level_stats_multiplier_dino_tamed_ty.title: Tamed creature stat multipliers
per_level_stats_multiplier_dino_tamed_ty.description: One indexed value per line, such as [0]=1.0, _Add[0]=1.0, or _Affinity[0]=1.0. Full PerLevelStatsMultiplier_DinoTamed keys are also accepted; blank uses game defaults.

per_level_stats_multiplier_dino_wild_int.title: Wild creature stat multipliers
per_level_stats_multiplier_dino_wild_int.description: One indexed value per line, such as [0]=1.0. The PerLevelStatsMultiplier_DinoWild prefix is optional; blank uses game defaults.
